context: Evaluates the candidate's ability to write advanced TypeScript conditional and mapped types. The task requires recursive mapped types, conditional type distribution, and use of the `infer` keyword for Promise unwrapping. All solutions must be pure type-level code with no runtime implementation.

checklist.name: Recursive mapped type
checklist.description: Implements DeepReadonly using a mapped type (`{ readonly [K in keyof T]: DeepReadonly<T[K]> }`) that recurses into nested objects

checklist.name: Primitive pass-through condition
checklist.description: Uses a conditional check (e.g. `T extends object`) to stop recursion at primitive types and return T unchanged

checklist.name: Conditional type for nullable removal
checklist.description: Uses `T extends null | undefined ? never : T` (or NonNullable<T>) to strip null/undefined from a union type

checklist.name: infer keyword for Promise unwrapping
checklist.description: Uses `T extends Promise<infer U>` with the `infer` keyword to extract the resolved type from a Promise

checklist.name: Recursive Awaited unwrapping
checklist.description: Recursively calls Awaited<U> in the true branch to handle nested Promises like Promise<Promise<number>>
